name: cbl-challenge-coach
description: Coaches a solo learner through Challenge-Based Learning to find and validate a real problem worth solving, and generate evidence-traced solution concepts.

plugins.name: cbl-challenge-coach
plugins.description: Coaches an individual learner through Challenge-Based Learning (Engage, Investigate, Act) to turn a vague problem instinct — or no idea at all yet — into a validated, evidence-tested challenge statement and evidence-traced solution concepts.
